integrity: The analytic proof uses the source normalization, positive leading eigenfunctions, pointwise kernel comparison, exact row integration, strict concavity, Rayleigh quotients, and Schur's test. The numerical example is supplementary and reproducible from the source-certified endpoint interval.
scientific_limitations: The enclosure is sufficient and explicit but is not claimed optimal; it treats only the unweighted Hermite-rank-two path and does not identify a second-order coefficient or modify the underlying stochastic LIL assumptions.
title: A closed-form remainder for the unweighted rank-two LIL boundary law
